hook: Wesley So faced considerable middlegame difficulties before securing a brilliant victory in Saint Louis.

sections.voiceover: Wesley So faced considerable middlegame difficulties before securing a brilliant victory in Saint Louis.
On October 10, 2026, Wesley So faced Jeffery Xiong in round two at the 2026 U.S. Chess Championship in Saint Louis. How did he win?
The game turned at move 21 when a single knight move attacked two rooks.
So forced a 1-0 result, bringing his tournament score to 2 points. This win kept him tied for the lead. His precision on board 6 proved decisive against Xiong's 2656 rating.
Wesley So remains undefeated with two perfect points in the tournament.
